source.headline: Canada’s retaliatory tariffs worth $27.6 billion take effect as trade rift with U.S. deepens

predictions.mechanism: New tariffs broaden North American trade friction and add a modest inflation/earnings-risk premium to U.S. equities.
predictions.invalidation: Rapid negotiated suspension of the tariffs or a strong risk-on move that fully absorbs the trade shock.

predictions.mechanism: Tariff escalation adds inflation and policy uncertainty, modestly negative for long-duration technology valuations.
predictions.invalidation: Trade tensions de-escalate quickly or falling yields dominate the tariff effect.

predictions.mechanism: Industrials and multinational firms face added cross-border cost and demand uncertainty from retaliatory tariffs.
predictions.invalidation: Immediate trade compromise or evidence the covered goods have negligible earnings impact.

predictions.mechanism: Trade friction adds a small safe-haven and inflation hedge bid, but elevated rates limit conviction.
predictions.invalidation: Trade de-escalation and rising real yields overwhelm the modest safe-haven impulse.
